description: Defines a custom exception class 'ClientErrorException' indicating client-side errors in a service invocation context. It extends 'ServiceInvocationException' and provides multiple constructors to create instances with error code, message, and cause, with validation that the error code is within the 400-499 range.

classes.name: ClientErrorException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing client error responses, typically used when an operation fails due to client-side issues such as invalid input or request errors.

methods.name: ClientErrorException(int)
methods.description: Constructor creating an exception instance with an error code. Valid error codes are between 400 and 499.

methods.name: ClientErrorException(int, String)
methods.description: Constructor with an error code and a message describing the error.

methods.name: ClientErrorException(int, Throwable)
methods.description: Constructor with an error code and a throwable cause.

methods.name: ClientErrorException(int, String, Throwable)
methods.description: Constructor with an error code, message, and cause; performs validation on the error code.
